networkDependency: offline — replay consumes locally available historical candles; no network call required for the sanity path
mechanism: Replay reconstructs its liquidity context from the same liquidity domain the live engine uses. The 3 calendar generators (liquidity/dailyLiquidity.js, weeklyLiquidity.js, monthlyLiquidity.js) are deleted, and liquidityRegistry.add() rejects PDH/PDL/PWH/PWL/PMH/PML. Therefore replay can never emit or consume the 6 removed types — output count is 0 by construction.
